About Research and Development
To support the creation of a more prosperous society connected by trust, our R&D resources are focused on five core technologies that contribute to sustainable development for society and the planet.
Computing power to accelerate data processing; Networks to deliver large amounts of data quickly and securely; Data & Security to promote safe, secure use of data; AI to create new value from data; and Converging Technologies to implement data into society and everyday life.
These are the five axes along which Fujitsu is delivering technologies that are truly vital to solving social issues.
